$comment: MF-14 · THE one closed layout table of the REPORT renderer (Spec 126 11a.7 dated note 2026-11-09; operator T-1..T-4). One row per target; the renderer reads it and holds no copy (R-27). columns = count at the widest breakpoint (1 at phone width everywhere); details = the non-headline block; meta = when the confidence and provenance line shows; page_break = where print breaks. No per-field or per-state entry. Closed value sets are in `closed`; a lock checks the rows against them and the keys against TARGETS.
